title: I replaced Perplexity with a local LLM on Android to get instant offline search answers
excerpt: Here is what I learned in my experiment
content_html:
Published Aug 13, 2026, 8:15 AM EDT

When I need to search the internet, I don't open Google anymore. Instead, I use Perplexity, though it isn't my newfound love — it replaced Google Search on all my devices a long time ago.

Although I feel Perplexity hasn't improved at the pace it should have, thus lagging behind its competitors, I keep coming back to it for its awesome web search results.

However, that's not the only instance when I use Perplexity. I often use Perplexity for questions I don't require a web search for.

I needed to break that habit, so I came up with a plan to see whether something else could take its place for questions I don't need a web search for. A local Large Language Model (LLM) was the only solution.

I did it on my Android phone. I replaced Perplexity with a local LLM on Android to get instant answers without an internet connection. Here's what I found in my experiment.

Quiz

8 Questions · Test Your Knowledge

Perplexity and local LLMs
Trivia challenge

Think you know your AI search engines and on-device language models? Put your knowledge to the test.

01 / 8

AI Search

What is Perplexity AI primarily designed to do?

Correct! Perplexity AI acts as an 'answer engine,' combining live web search with large language model reasoning to deliver sourced, conversational responses. Unlike a traditional search engine, it synthesizes information rather than just listing links.

Not quite. Perplexity AI is best described as an answer engine — it searches the web in real time and uses LLMs to present cited, conversational answers rather than raw search results. Image generation and audio transcription are handled by other specialized tools.

02 / 8

Local LLMs

Which open-source tool is most widely used to run large language models locally on a personal computer?

Correct! Ollama has become the go-to command-line tool for pulling and running LLMs locally, making models like Llama, Mistral, and Gemma accessible with just a few terminal commands. Its simplicity and broad model library have made it a community favorite.

Not quite. While LM Studio and Jan.ai are excellent GUI-based options, Ollama is the most widely adopted tool for running local LLMs, especially among developers who prefer a lightweight command-line workflow. It supports a huge library of models and integrates easily with other apps.

03 / 8

Models

Meta's open-weight model family, which powers many local LLM setups, is known as what?

Correct! Meta's Llama (Large Language Model Meta AI) series — including Llama 2 and Llama 3 — has become the backbone of the local AI movement. Its open-weight releases allowed developers and researchers worldwide to fine-tune and deploy powerful models without cloud dependency.

Not quite. The answer is Llama, Meta's open-weight model family. While Falcon (from TII), Mistral (from Mistral AI), and Gemma (from Google) are all prominent open models used locally, it is Meta's Llama series that ignited the local LLM revolution when it was first leaked and later officially released.

04 / 8

Privacy

What is one of the biggest privacy advantages of running an LLM locally rather than using a cloud-based service like Perplexity?

Correct! When you run an LLM locally, all processing happens on your own hardware, meaning sensitive prompts, documents, and conversations stay entirely on your device. This makes local LLMs especially appealing for handling confidential business data or personal information.

Not quite. The key privacy benefit of local LLMs is that your data never leaves your machine — no prompts are sent to external servers, and no company can log or analyze your queries. Cloud services like Perplexity, while convenient, transmit your input to remote servers to generate responses.

05 / 8

AI Search

Perplexity AI controversially introduced a feature in 2024 that summarized web pages without sending traffic to publishers. What was this feature called?

Correct! Perplexity's 'Pages' feature generated fully formatted articles from web research, drawing criticism from publishers who argued it replicated their content without driving referral traffic. The controversy reignited broader debates about AI and fair use in the media industry.

Not quite. The feature in question was called 'Pages,' and it allowed Perplexity to produce polished, article-style summaries of topics sourced from the web. Publishers like Condé Nast and News Corp raised objections, arguing it scraped and repackaged their content without compensation or traffic.

06 / 8

Tech

What does the term 'quantization' mean in the context of running local LLMs?

Correct! Quantization compresses a model by representing its weights in lower bit formats — such as 4-bit instead of 16-bit — dramatically reducing RAM requirements with minimal quality loss. This technique is what makes it possible to run surprisingly capable models on consumer hardware like a gaming PC or even a MacBook.

Not quite. Quantization refers to reducing the precision of a model's numerical weights (for example, from 32-bit floats down to 4-bit integers). This shrinks the model's memory footprint significantly, enabling large models to run on hardware that would otherwise struggle, at the cost of only a small reduction in output quality.

07 / 8

Models

Which company developed the Mistral 7B model, one of the most celebrated efficient open-weight LLMs?

Correct! Mistral AI, a Paris-based startup founded in 2023 by former DeepMind and Meta researchers, released Mistral 7B and stunned the AI community by outperforming much larger models on several benchmarks. The company has since released Mixtral and other models that continue to push the frontier of efficient open-weight AI.

Not quite. Mistral 7B was created by Mistral AI, a French startup that launched in 2023 with backing from prominent European investors. Its founders came from DeepMind and Meta, and the company quickly gained a reputation for releasing highly capable models that punch well above their weight class.

08 / 8

Local LLMs

Apple Silicon Macs have become popular for running local LLMs. What hardware feature makes them particularly well-suited for this task?

Correct! Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture means the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine all share the same high-bandwidth memory pool. This allows a Mac with 32GB or 64GB of unified RAM to load and run surprisingly large quantized models at usable speeds, making it one of the best consumer platforms for local AI inference.

Not quite. The key advantage is unified memory — Apple Silicon chips share a single fast memory pool across the CPU and GPU rather than having separate pools. This means a MacBook Pro with 64GB RAM can effectively use all of that memory for model weights, something traditional PC setups with discrete GPUs and their limited VRAM cannot easily match.

My local LLM was good at little things that don't need the internet

It was still unreliable

Google's Edge Gallery app is, hands down, the easiest way to run local LLMs on your Android phone, so I didn't waste time looking elsewhere and installed the app on my phone.

Installing Gemma 4 E2B was just as easy. All I had to do was download it from the Edge Gallery app, and it was ready to answer my questions.

After struggling for a few minutes to decide which prompt to use, I gave it a bunch of high school math problems. While it passed the test with flying colors, it wasn't easy to read its equation because it wasn't properly formatted.

I also noticed that it over-answers even the simple prompts. I asked it to write a quadratic equation, and it responded with several forms of the equation, which I clearly didn't ask for.

I haven't checked, but I'm sure Perplexity would give me a much shorter answer with an explanation of what it means.

I don't do math anymore, so it isn't a deal-breaker for me. But what was most disappointing is how much it hallucinates, even when answering factual questions.

Since its knowledge cutoff date is January 2025, I asked about events in 2024 or prior, and to my surprise, it gave me wrong answers multiple times.

In my next prompt, I uploaded an image of my balcony and asked it to suggest colors to paint my walls.

I really loved the comprehensive answer this time, as it gave me all the options for different moods based on the color of the floor tiles and the surroundings.

I can surely consider Gemma 4 E2B my go-to for interior tips when I need to give my bedrooms and balcony a makeover in the future. I won't need Perplexity for this.

I also love its ability to summarize long text. It's also good at pulling specific information from a block of text and brainstorming concepts.

I am never going back to Perplexity for these types of tasks.

I couldn't stop reaching for Perplexity

Even when I didn't need the web

Old habits die hard, and I kept reaching for Perplexity out of habit in a week-long experiment more times than I would've liked. However, I won't blame it entirely on my habit.

The local LLM didn't immediately replace Perplexity because it simply wasn't as good. It performed well sometimes, and gave me wrong and painfully long answers in other instances.

So, it was a combination of habit that I had formed and the limitations of the local LLM. Another major problem with the local LLM was that it wasn't a seamless experience to resume chats.

When I restart or switch to it from another app, it takes some time to initialize the model. Also, finding your old chats isn't as easy as it should be.

I also had to switch to Perplexity in the middle of a conversation while using the local LLM when I wanted to ask follow-up questions requiring current information.

This suggests that I must limit the local LLM usage to specific tasks, like tips to do something, summarizing texts, drafting emails, and brainstorming ideas.

I still need Perplexity, but not for everything

A local LLM can't replace an AI model that browses the internet. However, local LLMs can handle many things that don't require a web search.

Sure, it has its flaws, but I'm hopeful that its accuracy will improve with future updates. This doesn't mean I'll wait for it to get better. Instead, I'll keep using it for everything that it is good at right now.

Even if it doesn't improve, its ability to run locally and not send your data to the cloud makes it worth using, especially if you take your privacy seriously like me. I'm staying.

sentences.en: What does the term 'quantization' mean in the context of running local LLMs?
sentences.zh: 在运行本地法学硕士的背景下，“量化”一词意味着什么？

sentences.en: ASplitting a model across multiple GPUs for faster inferenceBReducing the numerical precision of model weights to lower memory usageCAdding extra training data to improve a model's accuracyDEncrypting model weights to prevent unauthorized use
sentences.zh: A将模型拆分到多个 GPU 上以加快推理速度B降低模型权重的数值精度以降低内存使用量C添加额外的训练数据以提高模型的准确性D加密模型权重以防止未经授权的使用

blocks.html_en: Correct! Quantization compresses a model by representing its weights in lower bit formats — such as 4-bit instead of 16-bit — dramatically reducing RAM requirements with minimal quality loss. This technique is what makes it possible to run surprisingly capable models on consumer hardware like a gaming PC or even a MacBook.

sentences.en: Correct!
sentences.zh: 正确的！

sentences.en: Quantization compresses a model by representing its weights in lower bit formats — such as 4-bit instead of 16-bit — dramatically reducing RAM requirements with minimal quality loss.

当我需要搜索互联网时，我不再打开谷歌。 相反，我使用 Perplexity，尽管它不是我新发现的爱——它很久以前就取代了我所有设备上的 Google 搜索。

尽管我觉得 Perplexity 的改进速度没有达到应有的水平，因此落后于竞争对手，但我仍然会因为它出色的网络搜索结果而再次使用它。

然而，这并不是我使用 Perplexity 的唯一例子。 我经常使用 Perplexity 来解决不需要网络搜索的问题。

我需要打破这个习惯，所以我想出了一个计划，看看是否有其他东西可以代替我不需要网络搜索的问题。 本地大语言模型 (LLM) 是唯一的解决方案。

我是在我的 Android 手机上完成的。 我用 Android 上的本地法学硕士取代了 Perplexity，以便在没有互联网连接的情况下获得即时答案。 这是我在实验中发现的。

Perplexity AI 的主要设计目的是什么？

正确的！ Perplexity AI 充当“答案引擎”，将实时网络搜索与大型语言模型推理相结合，以提供源源不断的对话式响应。 与传统的搜索引擎不同，它综合信息而不仅仅是列出链接。

不完全是。 Perplexity AI 最好被描述为一个答案引擎——它实时搜索网络，并使用法学硕士提供引用的对话答案，而不是原始搜索结果。 图像生成和音频转录由其他专用工具处理。

正确的！ Ollama 已成为本地拉动和运行 LLM 的首选命令行工具，只需几个终端命令即可访问 Llama、Mistral 和 Gemma 等模型。 其简单性和广泛的模型库使其成为社区的最爱。

不完全是。 虽然 LM Studio 和 Jan.ai 是基于 GUI 的优秀选项，但 Ollama 是运行本地 LLM 最广泛采用的工具，特别是在喜欢轻量级命令行工作流程的开发人员中。 它支持庞大的模型库，并可轻松与其他应用程序集成。

正确的！ Meta 的 Llama（大型语言模型 Meta AI）系列——包括 Llama 2 和 Llama 3——已经成为本地人工智能运动的中坚力量。 其开放重量版本允许世界各地的开发人员和研究人员在不依赖云的情况下微调和部署强大的模型。

不完全是。 答案是 Llama，Meta 的开放重量模型系列。 虽然 Falcon（来自 TII）、Mistral（来自 Mistral AI）和 Gemma（来自 Google）都是本地使用的著名开放模型，但 Meta 的 Llama 系列在首次泄露和后来正式发布时点燃了本地 LLM 革命。

正确的！ 当您在本地运行 LLM 时，所有处理都在您自己的硬件上进行，这意味着敏感提示、文档和对话完全保留在您的设备上。 这使得本地法学硕士对于处理机密商业数据或个人信息特别有吸引力。

不完全是。 本地法学硕士的主要隐私优势是您的数据永远不会离开您的机器——不会向外部服务器发送提示，也没有公司可以记录或分析您的查询。 像 Perplexity 这样的云服务虽然很方便，但却可以将您的输入传输到远程服务器以生成响应。

不完全是。 这个功能被称为“页面”，它允许 Perplexity 生成来自网络的主题的精美的、文章风格的摘要。 康泰纳仕集团和新闻集团等出版商提出了反对意见，称其在没有补偿或流量的情况下抄袭并重新包装了他们的内容。

在运行本地法学硕士的背景下，“量化”一词意味着什么？

A将模型拆分到多个 GPU 上以加快推理速度B降低模型权重的数值精度以降低内存使用量C添加额外的训练数据以提高模型的准确性D加密模型权重以防止未经授权的使用

正确的！ 量化通过以较低位格式（例如 4 位而不是 16 位）表示模型权重来压缩模型，从而以最小的质量损失显着降低 RAM 要求。 这项技术使得在游戏 PC 甚至 MacBook 等消费类硬件上运行功能惊人的模型成为可能。

不完全是。 量化是指降低模型数值权重的精度（例如，从 32 位浮点数降低到 4 位整数）。 这显着缩小了模型的内存占用量，使大型模型能够在原本会陷入困境的硬件上运行，而代价只是输出质量略有下降。

不完全是。 Mistral 7B 由法国初创公司 Mistral AI 创建，该公司于 2023 年推出，得到了欧洲知名投资者的支持。 其创始人来自 DeepMind 和 Meta，该公司很快因发布远远超出其重量级别的高性能模型而享有盛誉。

Apple Silicon Mac 因运行本地法学硕士而变得流行。 哪些硬件功能使它们特别适合这项任务？

A它们包括与主芯片分离的专用神经协处理器B它们的统一内存架构允许GPU和CPU共享大型、快速的内存池C它们支持具有无限VRAMD的外部GPU外壳macOS包括由Apple优化的内置LLM推理运行时

正确的！ Apple Silicon 的统一内存架构意味着 CPU、GPU 和神经引擎都共享相同的高带宽内存池。 这使得具有 32GB 或 64GB 统一 RAM 的 Mac 能够以可用速度加载和运行令人惊讶的大型量化模型，使其成为本地 AI 推理的最佳消费平台之一。

不完全是。 关键优势是统一内存——Apple Silicon 芯片在 CPU 和 GPU 上共享单个快速内存池，而不是拥有单独的池。 这意味着配备 64GB RAM 的 MacBook Pro 可以有效地将所有内存用于模型权重，这是具有独立 GPU 和有限 VRAM 的传统 PC 设置无法轻易匹敌的。
